items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: If my brother was living... he's the one that composed all Creole songs. Really? El Abado. What was his name? Eulis.

ctx.x: Yeah? Yes, I did. Do you remember any of them that you used?
If my brother was living, and would be sitting right here now, he's the one that composed all Creole songs. Really? El Abado. What was his name? Eulis. Eulis. Eulis.
Uh-huh. Do you remember the names of any of the songs
